descriptionMarkdown:
Ruststalker Protocol; Gain proficiency with blades. Your melee attacks deal +1d6 damage against targets below half their hit points.

Ruststalker; Your melee attacks ignore resistance from non-powered armour.

Ruststalker; Your melee critical hits disable reactions until the target’s next turn.

Ruststalker; Your melee hits against bloodied targets deal +1d8 damage.
